incidents_catalogued.title: Reconciliation and Repair of Erroneous Narrative '23 TRAIN Datatakes' Claim
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: 40 TRAIN independent parent clusters / mission datatakes (out of 64 total across OPS-02: 40 TRAIN + 12 DEV + 12 HOLDOUT = 64; 132 TRAIN samples, 40 DEV samples, 40 HOLDOUT samples = 212 total samples).
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Typographical draft defect introduced in narrative description of LL-EXP07-019. The accompanying automated regression test derived 40 directly from the manifest and asserted len(datatakes) == 40, but the narrative text was not programmatically bound to the test assertion until C22-A.7.
incidents_catalogued.impact_assessment: DOCUMENTATION_ONLY. Exhaustive inspection of assemble_ops02_c14_dataset.py, train_exp07.py, rehearse_exp07_diag01_canonical_zero_step.py, and manifests confirms that 23 never existed as a variable, threshold, parameter, target, or metric denominator. DATASET_MEMBERSHIP_IMPACT = NONE. COMPUTATIONAL_PIPELINE_IMPACT = NONE.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Repaired LL-EXP07-019 in lesson registry, learning framework documentation, and C21 audit statement. Enhanced test_lesson_019 to assert narrative consistency. Installed test_exp07_p0_c22a7_independence_protocol_guardrails.py. Preserved historical reports with audit trail.

remediation_summary: Independence-unit definition (Parent Acquisition Cluster / Mission Datatake under GOV-RULE-077) and counts (40 TRAIN, 12 DEV, 12 HOLDOUT, 64 total) are forensically proven and protected under automated regression tests. Task declared READY_FOR_PROTOCOL_REPAIR_COMPLETE.
